question: An inkjet printer can print 8 lines/second and can print a document in 6 minutes. How much time would an LED printer take to print the same document if it can print 7 lines/second more than the inkjet printer?
solution:
**Given:**

An inkjet printer can print 8 lines/second and can print a document in 6 minutes. A LED printer can print 7 lines/second more than the inkjet printer.

**Formula used:**

Work done = rate × time

**Calculation:**

Number of lines in the document = 8 × 6 × 60 = 2880

Time taken for LED printer = (2880)/(15)=192 sec, which is 3 min 12 sec.

**∴ Time taken for the LED printer to print the document is 3 min 12 sec.**
